SYED BASHEERUDDIN SARWAR Hyderabad, India | +91 9381719317 | basheeruddin112@gmail.com LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/basheeruddinsarwar-s-58b392a3

Associate Technical Project Manager | MAQ Software Focus: Client Delivery • GenAI/RAG & Agentic delivery • HLA/HLD • Data Transformation (ETL) • Automation

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Associate Technical Project Manager with ~6 years in software delivery, with domain exposure across Legal,



Sustainability, and FMCG enterprise programs. Leads delivery end-to-end using Agile practices and Azure DevOps, Jira: scope/plans, stakeholder alignment, RAID/dependencies, UAT, releases, and transition to sustainment.

Partners with architects on high-level architecture/design (HLA/HLD) to translate business needs into system flows, integrations, data movement, and non-functional requirements early in the lifecycle.

Drives GenAI/RAG and agentic workstreams (LangGraph), data transformation using Azure tech stack, and automation using Large Language Models (LLM), Azure AI Search/vector databases, Power BI, and Python/SQL to improve data reliability and reduce manual effort. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Associate Technical Project Manager | MAQ Software | Hyderabad Client-facing delivery lead across Legal, Sustainability, and FMCG programs. Partner with architects on HLA/HLD, GenAI/RAG + agentic workflows (LangGraph), and Modern Data Platforms (Fabric/ADF/Databricks); drive automation and delivery governance via Azure DevOps/Jira through UAT and releases .

April 2023 – Present

Directed end-to-end delivery for multi-workstream enterprise initiatives across Legal, FMCG, and Sustainability; drove scope control, milestone tracking, and stakeholder alignment.

Co-led early-phase solution shaping with architects: translated client problem statements into initial HLA/HLD drafts (system flows, integrations, data movement, NFRs), iterating with architects to validate and finalize the design for sign- off.

Drove GenAI/RAG delivery as the program lead, defining the delivery plan, risks, and acceptance criteria; partnered with architects/engineers to review and guide retrieval design, evaluation approach, and integrations with LLMs + Azure AI Search/vector DBs, unblocking issues to keep releases on track. Led adoption of agentic workflows using LangGraph to orchestrate query routing, tool calling, and verification steps on top of RAG; improved reliability and reduced manual review.



Owned delivery governance for ETL/data transformation on ADF and Databricks, aligning engineering execution (Python/SQL) for migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation to ensure Power BI-ready datasets.

Program-managed the transition from email/Excel-based sustainability data collection to a web submission portal, supported by automated validation and ADF + Databricks (medallion) processing to reduce BU back-and-forth and improve data consistency for Power BI reporting.

Orchestrated Agile governance in Azure DevOps, Jira (ceremonies, sprint tracking, RAID and dependency management)



and presented delivery health and financial insights through MBR-style reporting. Improved user story cycle time from 15 to 10 days by enforcing readiness gates, dependency resolution, and WIP control.

Reduced escaped defects from 3 to 0 per release and maintained 95% Definition of Done (DoD) adherence through

release readiness checklists and evidence-based acceptance.

Orchestrated UAT and go-live readiness across multiple releases; improved post-launch stability through test planning, defect triage, and comprehensive handover documentation.

Senior Systems Engineer | Infosys Limited | Hyderabad Automation engineer focused on developing API and web regression testing. Built automation frameworks and CI execution pipelines to reduce manual effort and improve defect detection.

June 2018 – June 2021

Built and maintained Python/Selenium test automation to boost regression coverage and software reliability. • Designed an API testing approach that reduced false-negative defects by 20%, improving quality for the client. • Engineered customized API automation workflow, cutting execution effort from ~600 hours to ~1 hour (99%



reduction). Implemented Azure DevOps pipelines for scheduled and repeatable test execution, eliminating manual oversight for regression runs.

Built a lightweight utility to automate bug report distribution to stakeholders, improving visibility and speeding issue

turnaround.

INTERNSHIP

ICT Manager Intern | Greenko Energies Pvt. Ltd. | Hyderabad MBA summer intern supporting ICT leadership on cloud modernization and BI optimization. Focused on vendor coordination, capability assessment, and roadmap planning for data/analytics modernization.

April 2022 – June 2022



Supported day-to-day ICT governance: stakeholder syncs, status tracking, production issue monitoring, and escalation coordination across teams.

Partnered with external vendors to support implementation planning for AWS-based Data Warehouse and BI platform

initiatives.

Assessed current ICT capabilities and constraints; developed a phased roadmap with timelines to transition from on-

prem SQL servers to cloud-based solutions.

Conducted research and cost–benefit analysis for expanding ICT capabilities to include an AI/ML function, presenting

feasibility findings to stakeholders.

Assisted in improving BI/reporting visibility using Grafana and Power BI, contributing to dashboard performance and

usability enhancements.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA), 2023 | Indian Institute of Management (IIM), Kashipur

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E. - Electronics & Communication), 2018 | MJCET, Hyderabad

CERTIFICATIONS

Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate (2024) | Google Project Management: Professional Certificate, Coursera (2024) | Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (2021) | Google Data Analytics (2021) | Agile Project Management & Delivery (2021)

CORE SKILLS

Program & Delivery: Project Planning & Scheduling, Agile/Scrum, Workstream/Portfolio Tracking, RAID & Risk Mitigation, Dependency Management, Change Control, Executive Reporting (MBR), UAT & Release Management Architecture & GenAI: High-Level Architecture (HLA), High-Level Design (HLD), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, Large Language Models (LLM), Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus), Agentic Orchestration (LangGraph) Data & Analytics: ETL/Data Transformation, Data Quality & Reconciliation, Azure AI Search, Power BI, Tableau, Advanced Excel Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Jira, CI/CD Pipelines Engineering: Python, SQL, NoSQL, REST APIs, Selenium, C#, Java

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Associate Technical Project Manager | MAQ Software | Hyderabad Client-facing delivery lead across Legal, Sustainability, and FMCG programs. Partner with architects on HLA/HLD, GenAI/RAG + agentic workflows (LangGraph), and Modern Data Platforms (Fabric/ADF/Databricks); drive automation and delivery governance via Azure DevOps/Jira through UAT and releases .
April 2023 – Present
Directed end-to-end delivery for multi-workstream enterprise initiatives across Legal, FMCG, and Sustainability; drove scope control, milestone tracking, and stakeholder alignment.
Co-led early-phase solution shaping with architects: translated client problem statements into initial HLA/HLD drafts (system flows, integrations, data movement, NFRs), iterating with architects to validate and finalize the design for sign- off.
Drove GenAI/RAG delivery as the program lead, defining the delivery plan, risks, and acceptance criteria; partnered with architects/engineers to review and guide retrieval design, evaluation approach, and integrations with LLMs + Azure AI Search/vector DBs, unblocking issues to keep releases on track. Led adoption of agentic workflows using LangGraph to orchestrate query routing, tool calling, and verification steps on top of RAG; improved reliability and reduced manual review.

Owned delivery governance for ETL/data transformation on ADF and Databricks, aligning engineering execution (Python/SQL) for migration, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation to ensure Power BI-ready datasets.
Program-managed the transition from email/Excel-based sustainability data collection to a web submission portal, supported by automated validation and ADF + Databricks (medallion) processing to reduce BU back-and-forth and improve data consistency for Power BI reporting.
Orchestrated Agile governance in Azure DevOps, Jira (ceremonies, sprint tracking, RAID and dependency management)

and presented delivery health and financial insights through MBR-style reporting. Improved user story cycle time from 15 to 10 days by enforcing readiness gates, dependency resolution, and WIP control.
Reduced escaped defects from 3 to 0 per release and maintained 95% Definition of Done (DoD) adherence through
release readiness checklists and evidence-based acceptance.
Orchestrated UAT and go-live readiness across multiple releases; improved post-launch stability through test planning, defect triage, and comprehensive handover documentation.
Senior Systems Engineer | Infosys Limited | Hyderabad Automation engineer focused on developing API and web regression testing. Built automation frameworks and CI execution pipelines to reduce manual effort and improve defect detection.
June 2018 – June 2021
Built and maintained Python/Selenium test automation to boost regression coverage and software reliability. • Designed an API testing approach that reduced false-negative defects by 20%, improving quality for the client. • Engineered customized API automation workflow, cutting execution effort from ~600 hours to ~1 hour (99%

reduction). Implemented Azure DevOps pipelines for scheduled and repeatable test execution, eliminating manual oversight for regression runs.
Built a lightweight utility to automate bug report distribution to stakeholders, improving visibility and speeding issue
turnaround.
INTERNSHIP
ICT Manager Intern | Greenko Energies Pvt. Ltd. | Hyderabad MBA summer intern supporting ICT leadership on cloud modernization and BI optimization. Focused on vendor coordination, capability assessment, and roadmap planning for data/analytics modernization.
April 2022 – June 2022

Supported day-to-day ICT governance: stakeholder syncs, status tracking, production issue monitoring, and escalation coordination across teams.
Partnered with external vendors to support implementation planning for AWS-based Data Warehouse and BI platform
initiatives.
Assessed current ICT capabilities and constraints; developed a phased roadmap with timelines to transition from on-
prem SQL servers to cloud-based solutions.
Conducted research and cost–benefit analysis for expanding ICT capabilities to include an AI/ML function, presenting
feasibility findings to stakeholders.
Assisted in improving BI/reporting visibility using Grafana and Power BI, contributing to dashboard performance and
usability enhancements.
